scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Bench article, closed-form cell and complete hull identity
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 20; FLOAT-LEDGER.md The bench cell — article A and Closed-form cells and hierarchy
entries.units: object identity; geometry m; enclosed/displaced volume m3; kg
entries.method: Request separate matched object identifiers, drawings, architecture and assembly states with geometry/volume definitions, calibration and uncertainty before comparison across scales.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: An article, a sizing law and a complete hull have different boundaries. Mesh integration is not physical weighing; a scaled hull is not a new drawn design.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Structural numerator and complete installation inclusions
entries.existing_model_reference: FLOAT-LEDGER.md The bench cell — article A; MEMBER-CENSUS.md Film, close-up fittings and outfit; VERIFICATION-PLAN.md critical path
entries.units: kg; mass inclusion list; component identity
entries.method: Request itemized tube/member, joint, film/barrier, adhesive/seam, hardware/support and equipment inclusions on each matched object; preserve missing components explicitly.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Bare-lattice, interior-film and outer-envelope conventions differ. Outfit and unallocated mass are unknown, never zero; an older sealed-cell budget is not a repriced current hull.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Enclosed versus effective displacement and architecture packing
entries.existing_model_reference: FLOAT-LEDGER.md Ship 0 — the hull of record; The bench cell — article A; VERIFICATION-PLAN.md critical path
entries.units: m3; packing fraction dimensionless; kg/m3; geometry identity
entries.method: Request calibrated enclosed and effective displaced volumes, loaded-shape/skin geometry, packing and sealed-cell/whole-envelope identity with uncertainty and a declared denominator for each comparison.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Design, mesh, nominal and loaded-shape volumes cannot be swapped. Ambient space between sealed cells supplies no vacuum displacement; unmatched mass/volume conventions invalidate scale transfer.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matched pressure/load case and atmospheric comparison
entries.existing_model_reference: FLOAT-LEDGER.md headline pressure basis; Pressure schedule — not computed; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 20
entries.units: Pa; K; kg/m3; altitude m MSL; load-case identity
entries.method: Request external/internal pressure, temperature/density, altitude and transient/fault load histories with identified sizing and evaluation states on the same object.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Published structural rows are sized for full vacuum against sea-level pressure; altitude changes lift only. A staged pressure schedule is not computed. Sea-level and working-altitude comparisons do not establish a resized structure.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Record and favourable assumptions kept separate
entries.existing_model_reference: FLOAT-LEDGER.md Evidence and knockdowns; docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 20
entries.units: dimensionless safety/knockdown factors; allowable Pa; configuration identity
entries.method: Request matched material/coupon, knockdown, joint and drawn load-path provenance and applicable observations/uncertainty before transferring a declared basis.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Reviewed describes code, not verified inputs. Favourable knockdown and chord ceiling remain unverified. This boundary paper selects no material, cap, factor or allowable and does not duplicate the P4.5 material crosswalk.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Drawing versus bill disagreement and incomplete allocation
entries.existing_model_reference: MEMBER-CENSUS.md Both directions and Recorded disagreements
entries.units: m; m2; count; kg; signed difference; station/component identity
entries.method: Request station/section/connection identities, analytic or measured geometry provenance and a complete bill-to-drawing mapping with explicit missing counterparts and uncertainty.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Rendering segments are not physical counts; smeared/full-radius checks do not resolve stations or connections. Existing disagreements and unknown counterparts stand; no cap or section is approved.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Preserve nonfloating results and limits of sampled scale comparisons
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Question 20; FLOAT-LEDGER.md Size, safety margin and the float band and Superseded closure, reproduced
entries.units: source-row identity; basis; altitude; uncertainty units
entries.method: Request raw matched observations and provenance for any future cross-scale comparison, preserving failed cases, source versions, inclusion changes and invalidating conditions; require a separately recorded acceptance decision.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: No sampled hull in Question 20 floats as drawn on either stated basis/altitude. Positive formula bands and superseded ratios are not a current floating vehicle; historical tables cannot replace missing physical evidence.
